info.title: Mailroom API
info.description: Read Conversations, Proposals and Audit Trails, search the Knowledge Base, and ask for a redraft, with an API Token. Nothing here approves, rejects or sends: that takes a signed-in Operator on the page.

get.description: Conversations, urgent first, then oldest first, matching every filter given.

A Conversation with its Messages, Runs and current Proposal (its Draft, issues,
Citations, planned Actions, and the decision and Actions once decided).
Proposals waiting for an Operator's decision, oldest first.

The Conversation's Audit Trail, in order. A body cleared by the purge is null,
with `purged` true.

Counts by status, Priority and Category, and how long the oldest pending
Proposal has waited.

post.description:
Ask the business's Knowledge Base a question: an answer with its claims and
excerpts, or not found.

Ask for a pending Proposal to be drafted again with an instruction. It turns
Stale; the new Proposal waits for an Operator's approval on the page. Nothing is
sent.

ActionView.title: ActionView
ActionView.description: An Action assigned on approval, with what it will write.

Approval.title: Approval
Approval.description:
An Operator's decision on a Proposal, one per Proposal. `version` is the Proposal's
version the Operator decided on; `edited_draft` is set only when they changed the Draft,
and `price_override` only when they confirmed a blocked amount as their own quote.

AuditRecord.title: AuditRecord
AuditRecord.description: An AuditEvent as stored: its place in the Audit Trail and when it was recorded.

CalendarHold.title: CalendarHold
CalendarHold.description: A provisional calendar event for a Customer's date.

CheckIssue.title: CheckIssue
CheckIssue.description:
What the ProposalChecker found. A blocking issue stops the Proposal being approved as
it is; `span` is where it is in the Draft (start, end), for the page to highlight.

DraftAction.title: DraftAction
DraftAction.description:
An Action the model proposes besides the reply (LLM output): no recipient, no ids.
It carries the arguments of its kind and only those.

ExtractedFields.title: ExtractedFields
ExtractedFields.description: The facts a Conversation states (LLM output). Each is a value or Unknown.

InboxSummary.title: InboxSummary
InboxSummary.description:
Counts by status, Priority and Category (every value, 0 included; a Conversation
not yet triaged has neither Priority nor Category), and the oldest pending Proposal.

KnowledgeCitation.title: KnowledgeCitation
KnowledgeCitation.description:
A Knowledge Base excerpt as a Read Tool returned it in a Run, with the question whose
answer returned it: what a Draft may cite, and what the Operator sees it relied on.

KnowledgeClaim.title: KnowledgeClaim
KnowledgeClaim.description: One statement from the Knowledge Base with the excerpts it rests on.

LeadArgs.title: LeadArgs
LeadArgs.description: A CRM lead as the model drafts it: no email, which code sets to the Customer's.

PendingApproval.title: PendingApproval
PendingApproval.description: A Proposal waiting for an Operator: proposed, not Stale, not decided.

ProposalView.title: ProposalView
ProposalView.description:
The Conversation's latest Proposal: what the agent proposed, what the ProposalChecker
found, and the Operator's decision and the Actions it assigned, if decided.

RedraftQueued.title: RedraftQueued
RedraftQueued.description:
The redraft is queued: `run_id` drafts again and ends in a new Proposal, which waits
for an Operator's approval on the page.

Unknown.title: Unknown
Unknown.description: An Extracted Field the Message does not state: a legal value, never a guess.
